issues.description: Field 'firstName' of class de.tum.in.ase.eist.model.Person has conflicting visibility across artifacts. The problem statement UML documents Person.firstName as a private attribute (Problem Statement: lines 168-175 show '- firstName: String' consistent with private encapsulation). The template repository declares 'private String firstName;' (template: src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java, line 8). The solution repository exposes the field as 'public String firstName;' (solution: src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java, line 8). This discrepancy in access modifier (private vs public) can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and whether they should use the provided getter/setter methods or access the field directly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Prefer restoring encapsulation to match the UML and template: change the solution repository declaration from 'public String firstName;' to 'private String firstName;' and continue to use the existing getFirstName()/setFirstName(...) accessor methods. Alternatively, if public field access was intentional, update the problem statement and template to document and demonstrate that firstName is intentionally public (but restoring private visibility is recommended to avoid confusing students about encapsulation).
